articles.title: ‘Served nation for 21 yrs, now my nationality is being doubted’: Kargil war veteran out of Bengal voter roll
articles.summary: Retired Indian Army Havildar Md Daud Ali, a Kargil War veteran from Murshidabad who served over two decades, is now fighting to prove his identity. Despite his dedicated service, including the 1999 conflict, he faces challenges affirming his citizenship. This situation highlights issues faced by some veterans regarding documentation and identity verification, demanding urgent attention.

articles.title: Sulfated Niobia and Zirconia Catalysts for the Synthesis of Ethyl Levulinate
articles.summary: This scientific work details a strategy for converting levulinic acid (LAc) into ethyl levulinate. This process is crucial for enhancing the value of compounds derived from lignocellulosic biomass-based biorefineries. The research contributes to optimizing sustainable resource utilization, transforming plant-based materials into more valuable products, and advancing green chemistry solutions for potential applications in renewable energy and materials.
